tool_args.rationale: The probe crosses the archived critical-gradient range and reveals a steep decline consistent with an avalanche. Fit all five mechanism parameters numerically and test the resulting law on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient observations fall sharply and become negative, unlike the pilot's smooth saturation.
The high-gradient probe supplies eight observations and identifies the archived threshold mechanism; a trajectory batch is not needed for this static candidate.
The abrupt high-gradient decline is more directly explained by the observed supercritical threshold.
